what_it_is.quote: A PowerShell process was started with an encoded command argument.

why_it_flags.quote: Fires when powershell.exe or pwsh.exe runs with -enc or -EncodedCommand.

esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\powershell.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\pwsh.exe")) and (process.command_line like "* -enc *" or process.command_line like "* -EncodedCommand *")

kql.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\pwsh.exe") and (ProcessCommandLine contains " -enc " or ProcessCommandLine contains " -EncodedCommand ")

title: Encoded PowerShell command line
triage_tips: Decode the blob (base64, UTF-16LE) and read it before judging.
what_it_is: A PowerShell process was started with an encoded command argument.
why_it_flags: It fires when powershell.exe or pwsh.exe runs with -enc or -EncodedCommand.
